chunks.text: Hi, I'm Aaron. These are my working notes. Much of these notes/writings are written for my own consumption, i.e. #evergreen notes. They began as a [digital garden](/thoughts/Digital-garden) built with [Quartz](https://quartz.jzhao.xyz/). They have since become my working notebooks. You can find out more about me at the apex domain.. This layout is credited to [Andy Matuschak](https://notes.andymatuschak.org/). I also [work](/thoughts/craft) quite a bit these days, so notes might appear unfinished (that's the whole point.) Here are a few things that I like: - [Wittgenstein](/thoughts/Wittgenstein), [Deleuze](/thoughts/Gilles-Deleuze) and [Camus](/thoughts/Camus) - [determinism](/thoughts/Determinism) - [hermeneutics](/thoughts/hermeneutics) - [functionalism](/thoughts/functionalism) - Michel Foucault's [The Archaeology of Knowledge](/library/The-Archaeology-of-Knowledge) - [interpretability megalist](/thoughts/mechanistic-interpretability) - high-performance [inference](/thoughts/vllm) [engines](/thoughts/LLMs) - [dimension-3](/thoughts/topology) #math/topology - [algebraic geometry](/thoughts/algebraic-geometry) - [homeomorphism](/thoughts/homeomorphism) - [Sets](/thoughts/Sets) :wave: you can also reach out via [twitter](https://twitter.com/aarnphm) or [email](mailto:contact@aarnphm.xyz), I always love meeting new people! If you are familiar with PGP encryption, you can use this key to send me email: `gpg --locate-keys contact@aarnphm.xyz`
